ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; visible surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to less than 2% of the total surface area, primarily localized at the margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and a vertical depth roughly equal to 12% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; distinctive irregular jaggedness is more pronounced on the right lobe edge compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, characterized by a smooth taper on the left lobe and a more blunt terminal profile on the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete clusters of high-intensity white pixels localized at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant secondary V-shaped notch or indentation located on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately one-third of the lateral distance from the median notch to the right tip.
